name: Self-sealing perovskite panel
subtitle: cheap printed solar that seals its own cracks

effects.effect: cheap printable crystals turn sunlight into current almost as well as silicon
capsules in a plastic burst when it cracks and glue the crack shut

effect: cheap printable crystals turn sunlight into current almost as well as silicon
how: Printable perovskite solar could cost a fraction of silicon, but the crystals rot within months once a hairline crack lets in moisture. The panel's sealing layer is filled with tiny capsules that burst when it cracks and glue the gap shut, keeping water out for the decades a roof panel must last.
obstacle: Perovskites also break down from heat and light alone, so sealing cracks solves only part of the problem.
why: Self-healing perovskite films are studied; no capsule-sealed module exists.
real: Self-healing perovskite encapsulants have been demonstrated only with intrinsic polymers (ion-aggregate epoxy, Science Advances 2025); no microcapsule-based crack-sealing encapsulant for perovskite modules was found.
